The scoped investigation is complete. The strongest new theorem candidates are the higher-power modification family and the exact saturation of the October5 commuting frame. This checkpoint does not claim external validation or historical novelty.

## Exact output and scientific consequence

For every q≥2 and odd m≥3, the own candidate family is

`A(q,m)=C[p,s,u,F,J]/(H)`, `X=s²+u^m+p^qF`,
`H=X²F−(1+2sX)J−p^qJ²−p^(q−1)u`.

The written M1–M15 argument constructs polynomial coordinates and their inverse on `A(q,m)[w]`, proves every p-fibre is A³, and derives nonpolynomiality of A(q,m). It combines the source's denominator-clearing/quadric transfer with a q-independent second-order extraction: if the extracted derivation moves the exceptional generator v, its valuation forces `E²v=0` for every q≥2. Odd-m rigidity then excludes the required action. This is a parameterized extension of the fully read September23 source's q2,m3 construction. It does not distinguish parameter isomorphism classes, address even m or q1, or prove three-dimensional cancellation.

For the October5 source's explicit degree-five f, acquired division-free polynomial maps give `Ψ:A⁵→A⁵` with first coordinate f and an explicit inverse. The original commuting frame on A=C⁴ is `D_i=p²∂i` in `A[p^-1]=C[p±1,X,Y,Z]`. Its rank is3 off p0,1 on p0/u≠0, and0 on p=u0; its fixed ideal is exactly(p,u), with fixed scheme A². The own module theorem is

`(Σ C(p)D_i) ∩ Der_C(A) = Σ C[p]D_i`.

Two exact boundary divisibility steps force any rational invariant coefficients to contain p². Thus the source frame is already saturated: invariant-span replacement cannot repair its degeneration even though all quotient fibres are polynomial rings. The vertical commuting centralizer is the same module; the all-LND-centralizer corollary additionally needs the source's independently reconstructed noncoordinate conclusion. The next meaningful coordinate/action mechanism must escape this centralizer, rather than rescale its basis.
